node.title: Prize N=256 square-mass-18 cofactor-514 exclusion
node.statement: On prize-envelope N=256 rows, profile-(4,2,0) cofactor 514 is impossible. Dual complete normalized censuses cover 320292000 signed vectors in the six residual variance chambers and leave 184 norms divisible by 257. FLINT and PARI agree on all 184 exact resultants, and every quotient Norm/514 lies strictly below the prize interval.
node.notes: EXACT FINITE EXCLUSION 2026-07-28: dual census and dual resultant engines reduce the leading prize profile from five to four live cofactors. Normalized vector counts are not used as weighted class-pair counts.
